frontend_calculations_summary.description: To minimize backend routes, these calculations are performed on the frontend using data from existing routes
dashboard_page: Consensus Badge (Strong Buy/Buy/Hold/Sell) = Majority vote from strategies array
Total Gain KPI = Sum of gain_dollars from /api/trades/closed
Temps Moyen KPI = Average temps_jours from /api/trades/closed
trade_page: Win/Loss Ratio = Count positive vs negative gains
All table filters (Symbol, Devise, Période, Performance) = Client-side
Total Profits = Sum of positive gain_dollars
wallet_page: Total Déposé = Sum of transactions where action='ajout'
Total Retiré = Sum of transactions where action='retrait'
Gains Réalisés = Sum from /api/trades/closed where gain_dollars > 0
Pertes Réalisées = Sum from /api/trades/closed where gain_dollars < 0
Vignette counts = Filter and count by transaction type
chart_page: OHLC Display = Extract from last candle in historical data
Volume bars = From historical data volume field

notes_for_frontend_team.authentication: Store JWT token after login/register. Add 'Authorization: Bearer {token}' header to all protected routes.
notes_for_frontend_team.error_handling: All errors return {error: 'message'}. Handle 401 (redirect to login), 403 (permission denied), 400 (validation), 500 (server error).
notes_for_frontend_team.currency_handling: All amounts are decimal numbers. Supported currencies: CAD, USD, EUR.
notes_for_frontend_team.calculations_frontend: Most KPIs and aggregations should be calculated client-side to reduce backend complexity. See 'frontend_calculations_summary' section.
notes_for_frontend_team.strategy_spheres: 5 colored spheres (B/H/S) displayed for each position. Colors: Buy=#10b981 (green), Hold=#f59e0b (orange), Sell=#ef4444 (red).
notes_for_frontend_team.consensus_logic: Count BUY/SELL/HOLD from strategies array. Majority determines badge: Strong Buy (4-5 BUY), Buy (3 BUY), Hold (3 HOLD or mixed), Sell (3 SELL), Strong Sell (4-5 SELL).
notes_for_frontend_team.percentage_calculations: Always calculate % as: (current_price - prix_moyen) / prix_moyen * 100. Display with + or - prefix and color accordingly.
notes_for_frontend_team.real_time_prices: current_price in /api/trades/open-with-recommendations is updated daily, NOT real-time tick data.
notes_for_frontend_team.pagination: Apply client-side on full dataset. No backend pagination needed for initial version.
notes_for_frontend_team.filters: All table filters (Symbol, Devise, Période, Performance) are client-side filters on full dataset.
notes_for_frontend_team.multi_sale_trades: When same symbol has multiple sales, display as indented rows with gray background. See trade.html for visual reference.
notes_for_frontend_team.empty_states: Handle empty arrays gracefully with appropriate messages (ex: 'Aucune position ouverte', 'Aucun trade fermé').
notes_for_frontend_team.loading_states: Show skeleton loaders or spinners while fetching data.
notes_for_frontend_team.responsive_design: All pages must be mobile-optimized. HTML uses Tailwind responsive classes (sm:, md:, lg:).
notes_for_frontend_team.email_verification: After registration, user receives email with verification link. Account is functional immediately but email_verified flag is false until verified.
notes_for_frontend_team.password_reset_flow: User requests reset → receives email with link → clicks link → enters new password → can login with new password.
notes_for_frontend_team.google_oauth_flow: Frontend gets id_token from Google → sends to /api/auth/google → receives JWT token + user info → redirect to dashboard.
